table.name: TLGNC_PDA_SESSION
table.description: Sessions of PDA users/devices. A session is created when a user starts the login process on the PDA and is associated with the PDA device and its current user. After an initializing phase (in status 'initializing') the session stays in status 'ready' as long as events are being received (see last_update_dat) and messages can be sent by Logon. After an inactivity period (configured by app.session.PDASessionTimeout_min) or when the user explicitely logs out, the session is set to status 'terminated'.

column.name: USER_ID
column.description: FK to TLGNC_USER, the user logged into this session.

column.name: PDA_DEVICE_ID
column.description: FK to TLGNC_PDA_DEVICE. Current PDA device of the user

column.name: PDA_SESSION_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK to TLGNR_PDA_SESSION_STATUS. 1=initializing, 2=ready (Application may send messages to this PDA), 3=terminated, 4=event pending, 5=timed out.

column.name: LAST_UPDATE_DAT
column.description: Date/Time of last event received from the PDA. If this is longer ago than app.session.PDASessionTimeout_min, the PDA session reaper background job will set the session to 'terminated' during its next execution.

column.name: LAST_RECEIVED_EVENT_NAME
column.description: Name of last event received from the PDA.
